```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, comment = "", message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

The script `q2_lda.R` builds the data frame, cleans the text, fits the model and saves the figures.
Running it here prints each step.

```{r}
source("q2_lda.R", echo = TRUE, max.deparse.length = Inf)
```
